Package org.unitseek.knitid.generator.biz

Record Class BizConfig

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.unitseek.knitid.generator.biz.BizConfig
Record Components:
template - output template, at most 128 characters
prefix - optional literal/context prefix, at most 16 characters
zoneId - time zone used for date/time placeholders and daily reset
nodeId - optional node id for the {worker} placeholder
sequenceProviderName - sequence provider bean name or memory
reset - sequence reset policy
checkAlgorithm - check-digit algorithm
public record BizConfig(String template, String prefix, ZoneId zoneId, Long nodeId, String sequenceProviderName, SequenceReset reset, CheckAlgorithm checkAlgorithm) extends Record
Immutable business-ID configuration.
Since:
1.0.0
